name: The Fused Plane of the Champ de Mars

location.address: Jardin du Champ de Mars, west foot of the Eiffel Tower, 75007 Paris

verified_sources: https://www.waymarking.com/waymarks/WMQW4Y_Platanus_acerifolia_Tour_Eiffel_Paris_France (six fused trunks at the foot of the tower, 48.85767,2.29322, 20 m from the register point)

official_register.name: Arbres remarquables de Paris (Ville de Paris), no. 108095

access: Public park, free. The tree stands at the foot of the Eiffel Tower, where the tower's grounds are enclosed; visitors normally pass a security check. Hours and entry point at the tower not verified.
transport: RER C Champ de Mars-Tour Eiffel or Bir-Hakeim (M6), roughly a 10 minute walk (estimated from the coordinates, not checked on a timetable).
verify_notes: Register 108095 (A.R.B.R.E.S. label 2015). Open-data register: girth 710 cm, height 25 m, planting date 'unknown'. The city's printed fact sheet and its 2015 label brochure both say planted 1814, 705 cm, 27 m (brochure 20 m): sheet says its shape probably comes from six trees planted in a tight group whose trunks fused ('probablement', not documented). Waymarking independently describes a six-trunk fused plane at the foot of the tower, 20 m from the register point, so the pin is corroborated. The sheet says it stands 'au bord de l'eau' (a pond lies at the tower's base; not checked). A plane tree where arborist Thomas Brail sat in June 2022 against felling for the OnE works was reported as 208 years old (planted 1814), but no source says it is this trunk; the city dropped the felling (linfodurable.fr, 2022). Alive: iNaturalist observation 2026-09-16 within radius (https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/400678086), not tree-specific. Register only for age, hence flagged.

name: The Plane of Square des Batignolles

location.address: Square des Batignolles, 144 rue Cardinet, 75017 Paris

verified_sources: https://capgeo.sig.paris.fr/PdfEtImages/ArbresRemarquables/PDF/135378.pdf (fact sheet for this tree's register entry, pair of planes)
https://capgeo.sig.paris.fr/PdfEtImages/ArbresRemarquables/PDF/135397.pdf (register link, the sheet itself returns HTTP 500)

official_register.name: Arbres remarquables de Paris (Ville de Paris), no. 135397

access: Free public square. Paris.fr lists seasonal hours, 25 Oct 2026 to 28 Feb 2027 Mon-Fri 08:00-17:45, Sat-Sun 09:00-17:45, longer from March (to 21:30 in summer).
transport: Pont-Cardinet and Malesherbes (per paris.fr), a few minutes' walk.
verify_notes: Register 135397 (A.R.B.R.E.S. label 2015): girth 604 cm, height 34 m, planting '1850' in the open data. The city's printed sheet (135378) covers two planes in the square, a London plane planted 1840 (595 cm, 28 m) and an oriental plane planted 1872 (442 cm); the only plane in the open-data register here is this one, so which sheet trunk it is is not certain. Planting dates conflict (1850 vs 1840), kept as a range. Square laid out 1862 to 1863 (Alphand), so the plane is said to predate it or be an older planting; no source reconciles that, do not bridge. A Time Out guide says four planes stand since the mid-19th century. 68 m from par_063 (the wingnut, same square); separate trunks, one visit. Alive: iNaturalist 2026-08-29 (https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/395512961), 2025-05-07 (/279272915). Register only, flagged.

name: The Giant Sequoia of Bagatelle

location.address: Parc de Bagatelle, route de Sevres a Neuilly, Bois de Boulogne, 75016 Paris

verified_sources: https://www.paris.fr/lieux/parc-de-bagatelle-1808 (captions a 'sequoia geant remarquable' near the Pagoda)

official_register.name: Arbres remarquables de Paris (Ville de Paris), no. 2002350

access: Paid entry at Bagatelle from 1 April to 30 September (paris.fr: 2.80 EUR full, 1.60 EUR reduced); free October to March. Hours from 25 Oct 2026 to 28 Feb 2027 09:30-17:00 daily, 09:30-20:00 from late March. Entrances: Grille d'Honneur (allee de Longchamp) and Grille de Sevres.
transport: Bus 244 stop Bagatelle-Pre Catelan; bus 43 weekends and public holidays (per paris.fr).
verify_notes: Register 2002350: girth 540 cm, height 30 m (sheet 511 cm, 28 m), planted '1850'. Age doubt: giant sequoia reached Europe only in 1853 to 1854 (general knowledge, not checked on a page this pass), so 1850 cannot be a literal planting date; kept as the city's figure, age given broad. The register point is 44 m from the Pagoda (Commons geotag), which agrees with paris.fr placing the remarkable sequoia near the Pagoda. Ticketed Apr to Sep. Alive: no recent tree-specific evidence (lifecheck returned an OLD Commons file 2011); the paris.fr page captions it as remarkable in a 2026 listing. Register plus the ground's owner; flagged for missing recent dated photo. 125 m from par_067.
